releases.notes:
## Download Mod 1.0.0

First release. Download Mod adds a menu to Minecraft where you can search Modrinth and install mods, resource packs, shaders and data packs without leaving the game.

### Features
- Download Mod button on the title screen and the pause menu.
- Tabs: Installed, Mods, Resource Packs, Data Packs, Shaders (shown when Iris is installed) and Servers.
- Search results update automatically a moment after you stop typing.
- Project page with description, screenshots, a full-screen gallery and links (Modrinth, source, issues, wiki, Discord).
- Required dependencies are added automatically; optional ones are not.
- Review screen before every install: see each file with its size, and remove a dependency you do not want.
- Installed detection by file hash, so it also works for files you downloaded by hand or renamed.
- Update button when a newer version exists.
- Versions button: pick any version that fits your Minecraft version (release, beta or alpha).
- Multi Download: collect projects across tabs and download them all at once.
- Data packs install into the world you are in, or you pick a world from a list.
- Restart Minecraft button after installing mods, with Attached and Detached modes.
- 15 well-known servers you can add to your server list in one click.
- Settings screen and images drawn at your real screen resolution.

### Safety
- Files are only downloaded from `cdn.modrinth.com`.
- Every file is checked against the SHA-512 hash from Modrinth. If it is missing or does not match, the file is deleted and the install stops.
- Nothing is downloaded until you confirm.
- No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21 to 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader and Fabric API
- Java 21

### Downloads
Pick the jar that matches your Minecraft version:

| Jar | Minecraft |
|---|---|
| `1.21-1.21.1` | 1.21 - 1.21.1 |
| `1.21.2-1.21.4` | 1.21.2 - 1.21.4 |
| `1.21.5` | 1.21.5 |
| `1.21.6-1.21.8` | 1.21.6 - 1.21.8 |
| `1.21.9-1.21.11` | 1.21.9 - 1.21.11 |

### Known limits
- Fabric only. No Forge, NeoForge or Quilt build.
- English only.
- Installs from Modrinth only. It does not search CurseForge.
- Restart is not supported by some launchers (Prism, MultiMC). They show Close Minecraft instead.
- Installed detection covers mods, resource packs and shaders. Data packs are not checked.

Download Mod uses Modrinth's public API. It is not made by, and is not affiliated with, Modrinth.
